items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You had an association with Giovanni Bonandrini. / Yeah, that’s right, unfortunately.

ctx.x: They originally appeared, though, on the Flying Dutchman label. I’m pretty sure about that.
Giovanni – it should have been on Giovanni’s label.
It did appear on his label also, in the ’80s. But the original recording was on Flying Dutchman in the late ’60s.
